RecencyGroups.note: The Conductor-style list in full: filter row, three recency groups with counts, leading-well ladder (spinner / PR / branch glyph), branch after the chevron, PR dot + number, ahead/behind and right-aligned last-used. The cmdk-selected first row correctly swaps its date for 'Go to →'.

WithCreateRow.note: Adds the dashed Create row with its ⌘N hint at the end of the list.

WithFilterRowAction.note: filterRowActions slot carrying the gh-auth note at the right edge of the filter row.

NoWorkspaces.note: Empty branch — CommandEmpty copy with the forceMount Create row still reachable below it.
